diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because no rollouts passed any content checks, meaning the model correctly defaulted to the baseline/draft values (e.g., 'two-day out-of-school suspension') rather than accessing hidden information. There are no leaks; the model is simply not being prompted or incentivized to find the specific values required by PF1, PF2, and PF3 through conversation.
fix_instructions: No changes needed to the checks themselves as they did not leak. To make the scenario solvable only via multi-agent interaction, ensure that the public facts (S1, S2) are insufficient to reach the correct values for C1-C8, and that the private facts (PF1, PF2, PF3) provide the only path to the correct settlement values.
